mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPI YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST YoY growth exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% QoQ signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% QoQ.
